projects.title: Campus Study-Room Scheduler (senior capstone)
projects.description: Team capstone for a web application that lets students reserve study rooms. Alex built the booking API and the conflict-checking logic and wrote the unit tests for it.
outcomes: Presented to the course instructor and classmates at the end of the semester.
Booking API covered by an automated unit test suite.

projects.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualizer (class project)
projects.description: Individual class project for an algorithms course. Implemented several sorting algorithms and a simple browser page that animates them step by step.

projects.title: Library Database Design (class project)
projects.description: Designed a relational schema for a small library, wrote SQL queries for common reports, and documented the design decisions.
